description: Add global accessibility and styling utilities to index.css: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule to disable animations for users who prefer reduced motion, confirm .no-scrollbar utility class exists, verify Google Fonts imports (Cairo, Noto Kufi Arabic, Inter) are loaded correctly. These utilities support accessibility requirements and visual consistency across the app.
steps: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule to Frontend/src/index.css after @layer base section, setting animation, transition to none for all elements
Verify .no-scrollbar utility class exists in index.css (should already be present from exploration); if missing, add webkit and standard scrollbar hiding
Verify @import url for Google Fonts (Cairo, Noto Kufi Arabic, Inter) is present at top of index.css with correct weights (400, 500, 600, 700) and display=swap
acceptance_criteria: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule is present and disables all animations and transitions
.no-scrollbar class hides scrollbars on webkit and standard browsers
All three Google Fonts (Cairo, Noto Kufi Arabic, Inter) load successfully
Browser DevTools: when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, animations should not play
npm run build completes without CSS warnings or errors
verification: npm run build — should complete with no CSS errors
Inspect source: verify @media rule and .no-scrollbar in compiled CSS
Browser DevTools > Rendering > prefers-reduced-motion: set to 'reduce', reload page, verify animations are disabled
findings: ✅ All requirements met: (1) Added @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule to index.css after @layer base section, disabling animations and transitions with !important. (2) Verified .no-scrollbar class exists with webkit and standard scrollbar hiding (-ms-overflow-style: none, scrollbar-width: none). (3) Verified Google Fonts imports at top of index.css: Cairo, Noto Kufi Arabic, Inter all loaded with correct weights (400, 500, 600, 700) and display=swap parameter. Build completed successfully without CSS errors.
